scripts.dev:server: cd apps/backend/server && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/backend/server && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck:api: cd apps/backend/server && uv run mypy app tests
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd apps/backend/server && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && cd apps/backend/server && uv run ruff format --check .
